description: Search for hotel listings on Trip.com by city and date.

checkIn.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank to use tomorrow's date.
checkIn.title: Check-in Date

checkOut.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave blank to use the day after check-in.
checkOut.title: Check-out Date

cityName.description: Name of the city to search for hotels. E.g. 'London', 'Paris', 'Tokyo', 'Bangkok'. Also accepts 'destination' as an alias. Supported regions: Europe, Asia, Middle East. US/Americas cities may return 0 results due to Trip.com frontend differences.
cityName.title: City Name

hotelId.description: Trip.com hotel ID to fetch detail for. E.g. '732036'. Used in hotelDetail mode.
hotelId.title: Hotel ID (mode=hotelDetail)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of hotels to return. Min 1, max 200.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPrice.description: Maximum price per night in USD. Leave blank for no limit.
maxPrice.title: Maximum Price Per Night (USD)

minRating.description: Minimum guest rating score (0-10). E.g. 7.0 for 'Good', 8.0 for 'Very Good'.
minRating.title: Minimum Guest Score

minStars.description: Minimum hotel star rating filter (1-5). Leave blank for no minimum.
minStars.title: Minimum Star Rating

mode.description: Scraping mode: 'searchHotels' to search by city, 'hotelDetail' to fetch a single hotel by its Trip.com hotel ID.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Recommended: use Apify Proxy AUTO group for reliable access.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

title: Trip.com Hotels Scraper Input
